title: Reviewing Internal Status Names (Inbound & Outbound)
titles: Reviewing System Defined Status Name Values
breadcrumbs: Reviewing System Defined Status Name Values

children:
You can use these windows to determine the names associated with inbound 
 or outbound system-defined statuses. These values are provided with the 
 system for all system defined statuses, such as check 
 in pending,   in putaway,   in wave, etc.

Access the appropriate 
 internal status name window. Open the appropriate record.

Review the value 
 in the Description Field. If necessary, you can change the value 
 in the Description Field.

Press OK. 
 The system will save your changes.

Reviewing Internal Status Names (Inbound & Outbound)
        You can use these windows to determine the names associated with inbound 
 or outbound system-defined statuses. These values are provided with the 
 system for all system defined statuses, such as check 
 in pending,   in putaway,   in wave, etc.

 internal status name window. Open the appropriate record.
            Review the value 
 in the Description Field. If necessary, you can change the value 
 in the Description Field.
            Press OK. 
 The system will save your changes.
